credentials.title: NFI Certified — specialty to confirm
credentials.lookupNote: NFI's public tool searches by location and by specialty (wood, gas, pellet, hearth design). It does not take a certificate number, so the strongest check a reader can run there is a name match against the list it returns.
credentials.relevance: NFI certifies knowledge of hearth appliances — the installation and service of wood, gas and pellet equipment.

credentials.issuerName: Society of Professional Rope Access Technicians
credentials.title: Level 1 Rope Access Technician
credentials.lookupNote: SPRAT runs a public certification verification system for technicians. It is the place to check the status this record claims.
credentials.relevance: Rope access is a way of reaching work on a steep or tall roof safely. It says nothing about chimney knowledge — it is about getting to the flue, not about what happens at it.

notChecked.label: Identity
notChecked.why: We matched a certification number to a name on an issuer's roster. We did not check that the person standing in front of you is that person, and we have no way to.

notChecked.label: Criminal background
notChecked.why: We ran no background check of any kind. Chimney.Services is not a background screener or a consumer reporting agency.

notChecked.label: Work quality
notChecked.why: We inspected no work, called no customer, and read no complaint history. A certification is a test result, not a record of jobs done well.

notChecked.label: Insurance
notChecked.why: We checked no policy. Liability and workers' compensation cover a company, not a person — insurance belongs on a company record, and there is no company record behind this one.
